content: Řḥukm issaggʷaden x Teɣzurt n Řewḥiy. “Min cem yuɣin ařami tgeɛɛded cem ak-d marra iwdan x tzeɣwin?
A cem, tenni iccuren s ddriz, a cem tandint izruddḥen, tandint ineggzen s řefraḥet: inni dayem ittwanɣen, war ttwanɣen s ssif u war mmten deg umenɣi.
Marra imgewwaden nnem munen arewřen, maca ttwaḥebbsen nhřa uřa d ict n tecti n řqews, marra inni dayem ufin, ttwacarfen, waxxa arewřen ɣar řaggʷaj.”
“X uya qqareɣ: ‘Saggʷejem xafi řxezrat, ejj ayi ad ruɣ s imeṭṭawen imerzagen. War d ayi ḥeṣṣarem ḥima ad ayi tɛezzam x wareddeǧ n yeǧis n řgens inu!’
Maɣar d ijj n wass n wezruddeḥ d uɛfas d uxarweḍ i dd-issekk Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat, di Teɣzurt n Řewḥiy, ijj n wass n weɣdař n řḥiḍ u n iɣuyyan i x dd-ttarran idurar.
Maɣar Ɛilam iṭṭef aqrab nnes s fřitcat, jmiɛ ak-d ukarru n umenɣi u ak-d aryaz nni t ineddhen d yinni inyin x yeysan, u Qir iɛarra taseddart n uɛeskari.
Ad imsar aqa řemxeyyer n teysarin nnec ad ttwaccuren s ikarruten n umenɣi u imnayen ad sedden ixef nsen i umenɣi arendad n tewwart n tendint.
Ad ikkes Netta arruḍ x Yahuda. Deg wass nni ad texzared ɣar řesnaḥ i iǧan di Taddart n Wezɣar.
Ad tẓarem tizzeyyin di tendint n Dawud, minzi aqa atent deg waṭṭas. Ad tessmunem aman n uyeřmam n wadday.
Ad tḥesbem tudrin n Urcalim uca ad thedmem tudrin ḥima ad tessjehdem řḥiḍ.
Ad teggem ijj n uyeřmam jar řeḥyuḍ, ḥima ad tessmunem aman n uyeřman aqdim, maca war txezzarem ɣar wenni t iggin, u war tḥeṭṭim wenni t iṣennɛen zeg wecḥař uya.”
“Deg wass nni ad iřaɣa Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat, maḥend ad trum, ad tesɣuyem, ad tḥeffem azeǧif u maḥend ad tyarḍem taxancet n wecḍan.
Maca xzar, řexxu aqa din arcaq d řefraḥet, neqqen ifunasen, ɣarṣen i wuǧi, ttᵉtten aysum u sessen binu, am qqaren: ‘Ejj aneɣ ad necc, ad nsu, maɣar tiwecca ad nemmet!’
Maca SIDI n řɛeskarat issargeb ayi x uya deg imezzuɣen inu, inna: ‘Řmuɛṣiyyet-a war ittwasseṣřeḥ i kenniw ař ɣa temmtem!’, ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat.”
Awař n Arebbi x Cibna d Ilyaqim
“Ammu i iqqar Sidi inu, SIDI n řɛeskarat: ‘Uyur, adef ɣar wewkiř nni, ɣar Cibna, řemqeddem n tzeddiɣt n ujeǧid, uca ini:
Min ɣarek iǧan danita, niɣ man wen ɣarek iǧan danita, aqa cek tneqced da ijj n wenḍeř i yixef nnec? Iwa ineqqec anḍeř nnes sennej, ineqqec i yixef nnes ict n tzeddiɣt di jjarf!
Xzar, SIDI ad zzayek iḥejjar s ijj n uḥejjar imɣar, Netta ad cek iṭṭef s ijj n wuḍuf iqseḥ.

Netta ad cek isseḥnunneḍ qaɛ ařami tdewřed d taqurart, ict n tcamma nni tt i ɣa nḍaren ɣar ict n temmurt temɣar. Dinni i ɣa temmted u dinni i ɣa iřin xenni ikarruten nnec icuwwaren, a cek řefḍiḥet n taddart n bab nnec!
Necc ad cek dd-ssuffɣeɣ zi řfusina nnec, wah, Netta ad cek dd-iqřeɛ zeg wemcan nnec.’”
“Deg wass nni ad řaɣiɣ i umsexxar inu Alyaqim, mmis n Ḥilqiya.
Necc ad as ssyarḍeɣ arruḍ nnec u Necc ad as beyseɣ abyas nnec u ad wceɣ tizemmar nnec deg ufus nnes. Netta ad yiři d babatsen i imezdaɣ n Urcalim d taddart n Yahuda.
Necc ad as ssarseɣ řmeftaḥ n taddart n Dawud x teɣruḍt nnes. Mařa netta ad yarzem, war izemmar uřa d ijj ad ibelleɛ, mařa netta ibelleɛ, war izemmar uřa d ijj ad yarzem.
Necc ad t wteɣ am řewted deg ijj n wemcan imten u netta ad yiři d řɛarc n uɛuǧi i taddart n babas.
Ad xas ayřen marra aɛuǧi n taddart n babas, iɣedduyen imeẓyanin d tɣeddutin, zi marra tiqcuɛin timeẓyanin, zi ṭṭbaṣi ař marra tiqnucin.
Deg wass nni ad ittwakkes řewted i ittwawten deg wemcan imetnen, iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat. Ad ittwaqḍeɛ u xenni ad iwḍa uca ddqeř i tuɣa ɣares yuyřen, ad ittwaqess, maɣar ammu i inna SIDI.”
